_: Overrides for the planner's built-in calibration (src/pww/plan/rounds.py).
The defaults live in CODE, not here, because rounds.residuals() checks the model
against the measured regimes at import time and a self-check that depends on an
editable config checks nothing. This file overrides; every entry it overrides must
carry its own quality flag, and an unlabelled number is refused rather than assumed
Deliberately NOT the scanner's plan.json: that file is read at import time and a
missing or malformed one makes the server refuse to boot, so every edit costs a
restart and loses the probe rows that land during it.

merge.provenance: merge-complete deltas across all four central logs, every membership: 15-19 s. fp32 weighted mean + Nesterov outer step + 5.29 GiB npz write. The only site-independent term.

xfer.provenance: solo fit-transport, central-latejoin (33.5 s) and central-churn (34 s), n=199 rounds

eval_fix.provenance: solo evaluate segment 25.5 s minus 512 windows / (3 x 89.8 seq/s) of forward-only validation compute

xfer.provenance: two-site fit-transport 97.7 s minus Snellius' identified 33.5 s. NO LUMI-SOLO ROUND EXISTS in any log, so this is a difference of two measurements, not a measurement.

eval_fix.provenance: two-site evaluate 64.7 s minus Snellius' 25.5 s minus 512/(3 x 38.2). Same caveat.

regimes.label: snellius@4 solo
regimes.note: 111-117 s over 98+100 solo rounds (latejoin, churn, full-run6)

regimes.label: snellius@1 solo, accum 5
regimes.note: balanced-LIVE. Out of sample for the fitted constants, so it is a real check of them.

regimes.label: snellius@1 + lumi@1
regimes.note: n=2 rounds, and NO additive form reproduces it. LUMI@1's predicted evaluate compute alone approaches the whole measured evaluate segment, so either that barrier is partly a MAX rather than a SUM, or validation.local_batch_size differs at reduced geometry. THE MEASUREMENT THAT CLOSES IT: one two-site 1-device round with PWW_VAL_WINDOWS logged, differenced merge-complete to merge-complete.

startup_cost_s._: c is an INPUT, not a guess, and it is not measurable from any existing log: no job script prints a timestamp before torchrun and Slurm writes no start line into logs/%x-%j.out. To measure it, add `date +%s > ${PWW_ROOT}/logs/jobstart-${SLURM_JOB_ID}` as the first command after the #SBATCH block, then diff against the first [titan] line; or sacct -j <id> -o Start on a login node. Until then these are LOWER BOUNDS and the c-sensitivity pass (c/2, c, 2c) runs on every plan.

snellius.provenance: first titan line to first training step: 10.9 s solo, 49 s federated-at-start; plus an unmeasured shell/venv prologue

lumi.provenance: 19.7 s solo, 157 s federated-at-start; plus a 13.5 GB sif exec on Lustre and the per-job MIOpen autotune warm-up (cache keyed on SLURM_JOB_ID, so every chain link re-pays it)

site_limits._: NOT readable from the aggregator VM -- there is no sbatch, sacct or scontrol on it -- and not recorded in the repo. Every value here is ASSUMED and the report echoes it as such. Verify with `scontrol show assoc_mgr account=<acct>` on a login node. Snellius priority is ~98% fairshare with a one-day decay half-life, so many submissions do cost queue position.
